name: Auth0 Authentication
description: Auth0 authentication integration for Next.js App Router using the real @auth0/nextjs-auth0 v4 API: an Auth0Client instance, middleware-mounted auth routes (no custom route handler), and server-side session checks.

sources.label: @auth0/nextjs-auth0 v4.29.0 README (Quickstart: env vars, Auth0Client, proxy.ts, session) — pinned above 4.0.0 because 4.0.0's peerDependencies cap at Next 15 and this catalog's nextjs-base pins Next 16

auth0/nextjs-auth0 v4.29.0 — latest v4.x with a Next 16 (^16.0.10) peerDependency range; v4.0.0 (2025-01-30) was the v3→v4 rewrite that introduced Auth0Client + middleware in place of handleAuth/withApiAuthRequired/withPageAuthRequired
Official v4.29.0 example app (with-shadcn): lib/auth0.ts + middleware.ts (this catalog uses the Next-16 proxy.ts rename of the same file — see authjs's proxy.ts.ejs for the same convention)
